facts.fact: The guide recommends a vertical 9:16 canvas so the video fills a phone screen.
facts.quote: Use a vertical 9:16 canvas so the video fills a phone screen.

facts.fact: The guide recommends choosing the 9:16 aspect ratio in Wavemaker before generating a draft so framing and captions fit a vertical screen.
facts.quote: Set the aspect ratio before generating so the framing and captions fit a vertical screen.

facts.fact: According to Adwave, analyzing a website in its tool is free, and users can see their plan before spending.
facts.quote: Free to analyze. See your plan before you spend.

facts.fact: Adwave says users pick a daily budget when they are ready to launch ads from their website.
facts.quote: Pick a daily budget when you are ready.

facts.fact: The guide advises estimating the credits needed for generation, revisions, and exports before starting a large batch of Wavemaker videos, and to check current plan details on Wavemaker's site.
facts.quote: Estimate the credits needed for generation, revisions, and exports before starting a large batch.

facts.fact: The guide states that a 9:16 video can also be used for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
facts.quote: A 9:16 video can also be used for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

facts.fact: The guide advises checking current length limits and music permissions for each platform before uploading a video to Reels or Shorts.
facts.quote: Check the current length limits and music permissions before uploading.

facts.fact: The guide advises keeping text away from areas covered by platform controls on vertical video.
facts.quote: Keep text away from areas covered by platform controls.
